direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Kasun has approached Anudi with her phone. Its return begins their connection.
direction.people: Only their hands and clothing are visible. Anudi is on the left in a cream blouse, receptive as she reaches for the phone; Kasun is on the right in a faded blue sleeve, offering it with relaxed fingers.

flow.text: Kasun supports the phone in his right hand as Anudi brings her right hand beneath it. The handset hides the transfer point.
Anudi secures the phone without visible hand contact. Kasun releases it and withdraws his right hand to the right.
Anudi draws the phone slightly toward herself, her fingers resting loosely around it. Kasun’s hand clears the frame.

direction.camera: A waist-height oblique insert with an 85mm macro lens holds the phone’s short horizontal path in a steady frame on a tripod.
direction.sound: Continuous light rain, distant road wash and faint sleeve movement; no music.
